persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrībhūpatīndramalladevasana bhūtayā kvāṭha pratiṣṭḥāyātā dayake se vijyāka

date.as_written: samvat (828 ) caitrakṛṣṇa caturdaśī jīvavāra saṃpūrṇa saṃvat 828

purpose: bhūtayā kvāṭha pratiṣṭḥāyātā dayake se vijyāka
notes: The manuscript seems to have been prepared in relation to King Bhūpatīndra Malla's consecration of a fort (kvāṭha).
